Description: Three fragments from Cave 5, inscribed in a Hasmonean hand, preserving the opening of 1 Kings: David's old age and the succession struggle in which Bathsheba and Nathan secure Solomon's anointing as king (1 Kings 1). It is the only biblical Kings copy from Cave 5.
Significance: The earliest of the three Qumran Kings copies by date range, and the only one preserving the very beginning of Kings; together with 4Q54 and 6Q4 it gives three independent Qumran witnesses to 1 Kings.
